notes.title: The second update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35198660/d076b1af84bc12aaae87fdecb376241bc45b4653.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! How you have noticed, the “Monsters of Little Haven” updates appear more often than the news about it. I follow the feedback regularly and fix the game. I post a small patch-notes of changes with today’s update:

[list]
[*] The opportunity to skip tittles if you have finished at least one ending is available now.
[*] The productivity for low-spec PC was increased.
[*] Some of the mistakes in text was fixed.
[/list]

Apart from the technical part, the game page on Steam was also updated. Also two DLC with game soundtracks are now available for free.

notes.title: First week update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35198660/367eb79bf0f5e7118ba044f57ac210f428856cc9.jpg[/img]

Hi! Thank you so much for your reviews! [b]It such a pleasure to see the feedback[/b] and watch streams with Monsters of Little Haven. It’s been a miracle, not a single critical mistake was found but I’ve fixed a few small errors with todays update.

[list]
[*]Now you’ve got an opportunity to choose the language of voiceover. [b]It was mainly done for English speaking audience. Due to a giant gap between atmospheres in different voiceovers we recommend to use an original Russian voiceover.[/b]
[*]The slide which could conflict with your final choice in «Monster» chapter was removed. Now that’s totally fine, the slide is deleted and nothing will disturb you in your journey to final chapters.
[*]The system of counting choices in «Murphy» chapter was fixed. No one has noticed but the result of one choice has conflicted with original idea of the game. However, you probably won’t find a difference even after the update.. Just so you know - I did my best.
[*]Few mistakes in text and following voiceover were fixed as other small things were as well.
[/list]

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35198660/a859182cb81466f0ca859150d14cc8b7d0aa595f.jpg[/img]

World and civil wars were left behind. Poverty and industrial hell also have started to sink into oblivion for everyone including Murphy family. 

They have found their place in a tiny village called Little Heaven on Welsh seaside. It was a tiny but also cozy area near the river. The hill where the Murphy’s house was build, protected them from turmoil of outside world. 

Until the children of the Murphy family hit the trail of a mysterious monster.

[h1]The secrets of Little Haven are waiting for you on July 10, 2019.[/h1]
